days.title: Fly JFK → Tokyo
days.dayNote:
- Leave home **Fri Oct 1 evening**: NH159 departs 02:00 on Sat Oct 2 (be at JFK T7 by ~23:30 Fri).
- Sleep on the plane; Haneda arrival ~05:00 Sun Oct 3 (JST).

cost.note: Estimate for a double/twin in early October (~¥32k–45k); not booked.

stay.note: Check-in ~14:00–15:00. Bags sent from Haneda arrivals by takkyubin: ask whether same-day delivery is possible, otherwise next day — keep an overnight kit in the carry-on.

days.dayNote:
**Lunch ideas** (after Gotokuji, before JINS opens 11:00): Uobei Shibuya Dogenzaka (tablet-order conveyor sushi), Gyukatsu Motomura Shibuya (queue), Ichiran Shibuya (ramen).

**Dinner ideas** (Shibuya / near the hotel): Shibuya Yokocho under Miyashita Park (izakaya alley — easy after the flight), Uogashi Nihon-ichi (standing sushi), or back in Shinjuku.

**Hotel:** Odakyu Hotel Century Southern Tower at Shinjuku's south exit (4 nights) — 3 min from the Fuji Excursion platform on Oct 7.

**Lunch ideas** (Asakusa / Kappabashi): Daikokuya (tendon), Asakusa Imahan (sukiyaki lunch sets), Sometaro (DIY okonomiyaki).

**Dinner ideas** (Ginza, before Bar Centifolia): Ginza Kagari (chicken paitan ramen; queue), Tonkatsu Bairin, or an **omakase** splurge at Sushi Kyubey (Random Notes: omakase — reserve ~1 month ahead).

**Nishikawa:** if COREDO Nihonbashi is closed for redevelopment, the pillow fitting is also planned in Osaka (Daimaru Shinsaibashi, Thu Oct 14 10:00) or use Hiroo Plaza — keep one, drop the other.

**Tax refund with passport** — since 2026-11-01 Japan uses a refund system: pay incl. tax, customs checks the goods at departure (KIX, Oct 14), then the store refunds (usually to the card). Keep the goods unused, receipts together, in carry-on reach.

**Lunch ideas** (Nakano): Aoba (Nakano's classic double-soup ramen) or the Nakano Sun Mall arcade.

**Dinner ideas** (Shinjuku, before Benfiddich): Tsunahachi (tempura since 1924), Fuunji (tsukemen; queue), yakitori in Omoide Yokocho.

Yodobashi / Bic Camera: tax refund with passport (tax-free counter queue 10–20 min).

**Lunch ideas:** Maisen Aoyama Honten (tonkatsu in a former bathhouse), Afuri Harajuku (yuzu shio ramen).

**Dinner ideas:** Harajuku Gyoza-ro (cheap and quick), or Shibuya.

**Tonight:** forward the big bags by takkyubin to **Nagoya JR Gate Tower Hotel** (check-in Oct 8; the front desk handles it, ~¥2,000–3,000 per bag) and carry only an overnight bag to the ryokan.

**Lunch:** hoto noodles at Hoto Fudo (the cloud-shaped Higashi Koiji branch, or the one near Kawaguchiko Station).

**Ryokan ideas** (Fuji-view room + private onsen — few rooms, book early): Kozantei Ubuya, Shuhokaku Kogetsu. The draft budgets ~¥90,000 for two incl. kaiseki dinner + breakfast. Confirm the dinner start (~18:00) when booking.

days.dayNote:
**Lunch:** Fujinomiya yakisoba — stalls by Shiraito Falls, or Omiya Yokocho by Fujisan Hongu Sengen Taisha if the bus runs via Fujinomiya Station.

**Dinner ideas** (around Nagoya Station): tebasaki wings at Sekai no Yamachan or Furaibo, miso-nikomi udon at Yamamotoya Sohonke, hitsumabushi (eel) at Bincho or Inau in the Esca mall.

**Tonight:** send the big bags by takkyubin to **Hotel Granvia Kyoto** (next-day, arrives Oct 9) so Ghibli Park is hands-free.

days.title: Nagoya · Ghibli Park → Kyoto

cost.note: Estimate for a 3-day-weekend Kyoto stay (~¥38k–60k); not booked.

stay.note: Late arrival ~20:05 (tell the hotel). Bags sent from Nagoya by takkyubin on Oct 8 are held at the front desk.

days.dayNote:
- **Breakfast:** Nagoya 'morning' culture — coffee comes with free toast + egg until ~11:00 (Komeda's Coffee has branches around the station).
- **Getting there:** Higashiyama Line Nagoya → Fujigaoka (~27 min) + Linimo → Ai·Chikyuhaku-kinen-koen (~13 min). Sat opening 09:00; final entry 16:30; closed Tuesdays.
- **Grand Warehouse** is the only area with a timed slot (09:00–14:00 hourly): pick 09:00 or 10:00 when buying.
- **Lunch** inside the park: eat early (~11:30) — noon queues are long.
- **Rain:** the Grand Warehouse is indoors; the other areas are outdoors — bring umbrellas.
- **Bags:** already sent to Kyoto; otherwise coin lockers at Nagoya Station.
- **Way back:** get off the Higashiyama Line at Kamejima (1 stop before Nagoya) for TSUTAYA Noritake, then walk ~15 min to the Shinkansen side.
- **No tickets?** Nagoya Castle + Osu shopping street, same evening train.

items.title: Breakfast · Nagoya 'morning' set
items.note: e.g. Komeda's Coffee near Nagoya Station: order a coffee before ~11:00 and toast + egg come free.

items.title: Ghibli Park · Grand Warehouse, Hill of Youth, Dondoko Forest

cost.note: O-sanpo Day Pass Premium, weekend adult price (all 5 areas incl. building interiors) — ghibli-park.jp, checked 2026-09-23.

items.note: Sat Oct 9: open 09:00–17:00 (final entry 16:30). Tickets are date-specific and sell out: sale opens on the 10th of the month two months ahead at 14:00 JST (→ 2027-08-10 14:00 JST). Grand Warehouse needs the timed slot on the ticket. Satsuki & Mei's House (Dondoko Forest) is 15–20 min on foot from the Grand Warehouse.

items.title: Lunch · in Ghibli Park
items.note: Cafés in the Grand Warehouse and the Valley of Witches; go before noon.

items.title: Ghibli Park · Mononoke Village + Valley of Witches
items.note: Howl's Castle and the House of Witches are included in the Premium pass. Leave by ~16:00.
Cities tab: 'Tsutaya Bookstore'. Two-storey lit bookshelf under a mirrored ceiling; staircase photos are officially discouraged. From Kamejima Station ~5 min.

items.title: Dinner · Yabaton Esca (miso katsu)
items.note: Right by the Shinkansen gates. Nagoya's other specialties (tebasaki, hitsumabushi) are in the Oct 8 note.

leg.label: Nozomi · Nagoya → Kyoto
leg.note: Nozomi runs every ~10 min; 19:15 is a placeholder — pick the exact train when booking (smartEX / JR). Seats open 1 month before at 10:00 JST; Sat Oct 9 starts a 3-day weekend, so book at opening. Big luggage (>160 cm total) needs an oversized-baggage seat — bags are forwarded, so skip it.

days.title: Kyoto · Fushimi Inari + Higashiyama
days.dayNote:
- **3-day weekend** (Sat–Mon Sports Day): everything is busy — Fushimi Inari at dawn and Kiyomizu before noon beat the worst.
- **Fushimi Inari:** JR Nara Line Kyoto → Inari (5 min; first trains ~05:30). Up to the Yotsutsuji viewpoint (~45 min) and back; the full summit loop adds ~1 h. Sunrise ~05:58.
- **Chawan-zaka**, the lane up to Kiyomizu, is lined with Kiyomizu-yaki pottery shops (Shopping List: ceramics).
- **Gion:** no photos in the private lanes off Hanamikoji (signed, fines); never chase maiko.
- **Nishiki:** most stalls close ~17:00–18:00; a few shut on Sundays. Aritsugu (knives) is at the east end (Shopping List: kitchen knives).
- **Kaiseki ideas:** Roan Kikunoi (counter kaiseki on Kiyamachi, Michelin-starred), Gion Karyo (approachable kaiseki), or a Pontocho kaiseki house. The Kamogawa riverside terraces (yuka) close Sept 30.
- **Bars:** Bee's Knees (speakeasy), L'Escamoteur (theatrical cocktails), Bar K6 (whisky) — all around Kiyamachi.
- **Rain plan:** swap Gion/Nishiki for Kyoto Station (Isetan, Porta) + Kyoto Railway Museum.

items.note: Dawn visit (Must): grounds open 24 h and free. Torii tunnels are near-empty before ~07:30.

items.title: Breakfast near Inari Station
items.note: Konbini by JR Inari Station, or a café once the shrine street opens (~08:30–09:00).
Opens 08:30 (Apr–mid-Nov), 1,001 Kannon statues; no photos inside. Keihan Fushimi-Inari → Shichijo, ~10 min.
Opens 06:00 (closing varies by season, ~18:00). Walk up Chawan-zaka (pottery) and leave via Sannenzaka/Ninenzaka.

items.title: Lunch near Ninenzaka
items.note: Ideas: yudofu at Okutan Kiyomizu, zenzai at Kasagiya (Ninenzaka, since 1914), or % Arabica Higashiyama for coffee. Weekend queues from 12:00 — go early. Then walk down to Shijo and across the river to Nishiki (~20 min).
Kyoto's Kitchen: tamagoyaki, pickles, soy-milk doughnuts, octopus-egg skewers. Aritsugu (knives since 1560) at the east end — tax refund with passport.

items.title: Break at the hotel
items.note: Up since 05:30 — rest before the evening (Karasuma subway from Shijo, ~10 min).
Best at dusk (sunset ~17:30): Yasaka Shrine → Hanamikoji → Shirakawa canal, then cross Shijo Bridge to Pontocho for dinner.

items.title: Dinner · kaiseki (Pontocho / Kiyamachi)

cost.note: Kyoto kaiseki dinner ~¥15k–30k per person + drinks

items.note: Random Notes: kaiseki. Ideas: Roan Kikunoi (Kiyamachi, counter kaiseki), Gion Karyo, or a Pontocho kaiseki house. Reserve 1–2 months ahead (phone / TableCheck / Omakase); check the closed day — some close on Sundays.

items.title: Cocktails near Kiyamachi (optional)
items.note: Bee's Knees, L'Escamoteur or Bar K6 — then a lantern-lit walk down Pontocho.

days.title: Kyoto · Arashiyama + Nijo + Philosopher's Path
days.dayNote:
- **Sports Day (national holiday):** museums normally closed Mondays are open; crowds everywhere — Bamboo Grove before ~08:00.
- **Getting there:** JR Sagano Line Kyoto → Saga-Arashiyama (~15 min).
- **Otagi Nenbutsu-ji:** taxi up (~10 min), then walk down through Saga-Toriimoto's preserved street (~35–40 min, downhill).
- **Miffy Sakura Kitchen:** the bakery often sells out by ~11:00.
- **Alternative afternoon (Sure why not):** Kinkaku-ji (09:00–17:00) + Ryoan-ji (08:00–17:00) by Randen instead of Nijo Castle.
- **Philosopher's Path:** start at Ginkaku-ji (optional, 08:30–17:00) and walk south to Nanzen-ji's brick aqueduct.
- **Dinner ideas:** Katsukura Sanjo (tonkatsu), Gion Okaru (curry udon), Kyoto Ramen Koji (Kyoto Station 10F).
- **Tonight:** send the big bags to Swissotel Nankai Osaka by takkyubin (next-day) — or use the same-day hands-free luggage counter at Kyoto Station tomorrow morning.
- **Ryokan option** (Action Timeline row 17 / Random Notes): make one Kyoto night a ryokan with a private onsen + kaiseki instead of the hotel.

items.title: Breakfast at the hotel
items.note: Or konbini — leave by ~07:00.
Must — go before ~08:00; the path is free and open 24 h.
Garden opens 08:30; enter by the north gate at the top of the Bamboo Grove.

leg.label: Taxi · Tenryu-ji → Otagi Nenbutsu-ji
leg.note: Taxis wait on the main street by Tenryu-ji's gate. Kyoto Bus 62/72 is infrequent; walking up is ~35 min.

items.note: Really want: 1,200 mossy rakan statues with funny faces. Opens 08:00, usually ~17:00.
Walk down via Saga-Toriimoto (~40 min). Miffy-shaped anpan; takeaway / standing counter only.

items.title: Lunch · Shigetsu (shojin ryori)
items.note: Zen vegetarian set inside Tenryu-ji. Holiday Monday — reserve. Backup: Arashiyama Yoshimura (soba with a river view) or yudofu nearby.
JR Saga-Arashiyama → Nijo (~10 min) + 10 min walk. 08:45–17:00, last entry 16:00; nightingale floors in the Ninomaru Palace.
Taxi from Nijo Castle to Ginkaku-ji (~20 min) or Tozai Line to Keage; walk the canal south (~2 km) in the late-afternoon light.

items.title: Dinner near Sanjo / Kawaramachi
items.note: Ideas: Katsukura Sanjo Honten (tonkatsu), Gion Okaru (curry udon), or an omakase counter (Random Notes: omakase — book ahead).

days.title: Kyoto → Uji → Nara → Osaka

stay.note: Bags forwarded from Kyoto (sent Oct 11) are held at the front desk.

days.dayNote:
- **Bags:** already on their way to the Osaka hotel — travel light today.
- **Uji (~1 h):** no Byodo-in (owner) — just the tea street: Tsuen by Uji Bridge (founded 1160), Itoh Kyuemon, Nakamura Tokichi. Buy matcha here (Shopping List: Matcha / tea). Kyoto → Uji: JR Nara Line (~20 min).
- **Uji → Nara:** JR Nara Line (~30–35 min), then walk ~15 min to Sanjo-dori / Higashimuki.
- **Nara:** Tue after a Monday holiday — Nara National Museum is closed today; Todai-ji (07:30–17:30 Apr–Oct) and the park are open. Deer crackers ~¥200. Kasuga Taisha (Sure why not) only if ahead of schedule.
- **Lunch ideas:** kamameshi, kakinoha-zushi (persimmon-leaf sushi), or Nakatanidou mochi as a snack.
- **Ikoma Sanjo:** weekdays 10:00–17:00, closed Thursdays (hence today); free entry, rides paid. It sits on the Kintetsu line between Nara and Namba.
- **Dotonbori:** takoyaki first (Kukuru, Wanaka, Acchichi-honpo), then okonomiyaki at Mizuno.

items.note: Matcha soft serve and tea shops (most open 09:00–10:00). Byodo-in skipped per owner.

items.title: Nakamura Tokichi Honten · matcha
items.note: On the way back to JR Uji (2 min). Takeaway keeps the stop short; the café queue can be 30–60 min.

items.title: Lunch near Higashimuki / Sanjo-dori
items.note: Kamameshi (rice pot), kakinoha-zushi, or udon in the Higashimuki arcade.
High-speed mochi pounding happens at irregular times and usually stops by ~15:00 — so it goes first.
Bowing deer, Kofuku-ji's five-storey pagoda on the way.
Great Buddha Hall: 07:30–17:30 (Apr–Oct). Squeeze through the pillar hole for luck.

leg.label: Kintetsu + Ikoma Cable · Nara → Mt. Ikoma
leg.note: IC cards (Suica/ICOCA) work on Kintetsu and the cable car. Change cars at Hozanji; cars run every ~20–30 min, so allow waits.

items.note: Want: retro hilltop park (Flying Tower from 1929) with views over Osaka. Weekday closing 17:00; closed Thursdays.

leg.label: Ikoma Cable + Kintetsu · Mt. Ikoma → Namba
leg.note: Take a train signed for Osaka-Namba (through service); last cars down leave shortly after the park closes — check on arrival.

items.note: Must: Glico sign from Ebisu Bridge, canal walk, takoyaki (Kukuru / Wanaka / Acchichi-honpo).

items.title: Dinner · Okonomiyaki Mizuno
items.note: No reservations; queue 30–60 min. Last order ~21:00.
Lantern alley one block south of Dotonbori; splash water on the moss-covered Fudo statue.

days.title: Osaka · Katsuoji, Umeda, Castle + Harukas
days.dayNote:
- **Katsuoji** (Must): 08:00–17:00, ¥500, daruma everywhere + a stamp rally. Midosuji Line runs through to Minoh-Kayano, then Hankyu Bus (~20–25 min, 2–3/h; check the platform and fare) or taxi (~20 min, ~¥3,400).
- **Travel-heavy day** (~3 h on trains/buses) because Katsuoji is in the hills north of the city.
- **Option after Katsuoji** (Sure why not): Cup Noodles Museum Ikeda (last entry 15:30) by taxi (~25 min), then Hankyu to Umeda — drop Osaka Castle if you do.
- **Whisky / sake** (Shopping List, no shop yet): Hankyu Umeda B1 liquor floor or Yodobashi Umeda — tax refund with passport. Bottles must go in the CHECKED bag on Oct 14 (or buy airside at KIX duty-free).
- **Harukas 300** at sunset (~17:25): tickets on 16F; open 09:00–22:00.
- **Shinsekai:** Tsutenkaku Tower (Sure why not) is open until ~20:00 if you want a second view.
- **Alternative day:** Universal Studios Japan (Want) — date-specific tickets + Express Pass (book ahead); Katsuoji then moves to Oct 14 morning (back by ~12:00).

leg.label: Midosuji Line + Hankyu Bus · Namba → Katsuoji

segments.lineName: Osaka Metro Midosuji Line (through to Kita-Osaka Kyuko)

leg.note: Check the train's destination reads Minoh-Kayano (some terminate earlier). Taxi from Minoh-Kayano ~20 min, ~¥3,400 — worth it if the bus just left.

items.note: Must. Buy a small daruma to write a wish on; the 6-stamp rally takes 30–60 min.

leg.label: Hankyu Bus + Midosuji Line · Katsuoji → Umeda

segments.lineName: Kita-Osaka Kyuko / Osaka Metro Midosuji Line

items.title: Lunch · Takimi Koji (Umeda Sky B1)
items.note: Retro Showa-style food alley in the Umeda Sky basement (okonomiyaki at Kiji is the famous one; closed Thursdays). Or the Hankyu Umeda food hall.
Open-air rooftop ring, 09:30–22:30 (last entry 22:00).

cost.note: Main Tower museum; ¥600–1,200 depending on the current price — verify

items.note: Midosuji → Hommachi → Chuo Line to Morinomiya (or Tanimachi 4-chome). Main Tower 09:00–17:00, last entry 16:30; the park and moats are free.
Sunset ~17:25. 09:00–22:00; buy tickets on 16F, lifts to 60F. Walk to Shinsekai afterwards (~10 min through Tennoji Park).

items.title: Dinner · Kushikatsu Daruma (Shinsekai)
items.note: Kushikatsu is Shinsekai's dish; the Billiken statue and Tsutenkaku are around the corner. Back to Namba: Dobutsuen-mae → Namba (Midosuji, 5 min).

days.title: Osaka → Seoul
days.dayNote:
- **Check-out:** leave bags with Swissotel's bell desk; the rapi:t leaves from Nankai Namba directly below.
- **Nishikawa pillow** (Shopping List): ~1 h fitting, ¥33,000 (¥44,000 premium), made the same day — confirm the pick-up time is before ~13:45.
- **Tax refund with passport** — since 2026-11-01 Japan uses a refund system: pay incl. tax, customs checks the goods at departure (KIX, Oct 14), then the store refunds (usually to the card). Keep the goods unused, receipts together, in carry-on reach.
- **Options** (Sure why not): Den Den Town or Namba Yasaka Shrine (lion-head stage) instead of more Shinsaibashi.
- **KIX:** the 14:30 rapi:t gives ~3 h before KE726 (18:15): customs tax-refund check BEFORE security, then check-in. rapi:t runs every ~30 min.

items.title: Breakfast · Kuromon Market
items.note: Many stalls open ~08:30–09:00: grilled scallops, tamagoyaki, wagyu skewers, fruit. Touristy and pricey, but fun (owner's note). ~10 min walk from the hotel.

items.title: Nishikawa · custom pillow fitting
items.note: Shopping List: Custom pillow. Reserve online (link on the place). **Tax refund with passport** — since 2026-11-01 Japan uses a refund system: pay incl. tax, customs checks the goods at departure (KIX, Oct 14), then the store refunds (usually to the card). Keep the goods unused, receipts together, in carry-on reach.
Want: covered arcade from Daimaru south to Dotonbori — drugstores, Uniqlo, PARCO. Tax refund with passport at the big stores.

leg.label: rapi:t · Namba → Kansai Airport
leg.note: All seats reserved; buy at the Nankai Namba counter/machines on the day or online. 14:30 is a placeholder — rapi:t runs every ~30 min. This leg ends at the KE726 departure item (KIX).

expenses.title: Kawaguchiko ryokan · 1 night (Fuji-view room + private onsen, dinner + breakfast)
expenses.note: Estimate for two incl. kaiseki dinner + breakfast (~¥70k–120k); not booked. Ideas: Kozantei Ubuya, Shuhokaku Kogetsu.

expenses.title: Luggage forwarding in Japan (takkyubin, ~4 transfers × 2 bags)
expenses.note: Haneda → Tokyo hotel (Oct 3), Tokyo → Nagoya (Oct 6), Nagoya → Kyoto (Oct 8), Kyoto → Osaka (Oct 11); ~¥2,000–3,000 per bag each time.

todos.text: Ghibli Park tickets for Sat Oct 9 go on sale — buy 2× O-sanpo Day Pass Premium (Grand Warehouse 09:00 or 10:00 slot)
todos.note: Sale opens on the 10th, two months ahead, at 14:00 JST (= 2027-08-10 01:00 ET). Weekend Premium ¥7,800 per adult. Sells out fast — be online at opening.

todos.text: Book the Nozomi Nagoya → Kyoto for Sat Oct 9 evening (2 reserved seats)
todos.note: JR reserved seats open 1 month before at 10:00 JST. Start of a 3-day weekend — book at opening.

todos.text: Reserve the Kyoto kaiseki dinner (Sun Oct 10, 18:30, 2 people)
todos.note: Most kaiseki places take bookings 1–2 months ahead (phone / TableCheck / Omakase). Check the closed day — some close on Sundays; swap with Oct 11 if needed.

todos.text: Reserve the Nishikawa pillow fitting at Daimaru Shinsaibashi (Thu Oct 14, 10:00)

todos.text: Book the Japan hotels: Tokyo Oct 3–7 (4 n), Nagoya Oct 8 (1 n), Kyoto Oct 9–12 (3 n), Osaka Oct 12–14 (2 n)
todos.note: Draft picks: Odakyu Hotel Century Southern Tower, Nagoya JR Gate Tower Hotel, Hotel Granvia Kyoto, Swissotel Nankai Osaka. Kyoto falls on a 3-day weekend (Oct 9–11) — book as soon as rates open (~12 months out), refundable rates.

todos.text: Decide: one Kyoto night in a ryokan with a private onsen (the draft keeps Hotel Granvia Oct 9–11)
todos.note: Best fit: Oct 11 (after Arashiyama), with kaiseki dinner at the ryokan instead of the Oct 11 dinner row. Small ryokan book up early.

todos.text: Send the big bags Nagoya hotel → Hotel Granvia Kyoto by takkyubin (next-day)

target.node: Japan|Nagoya|Nagoya Station|Nagoya JR Gate Tower Hotel

todos.note: Front desk handles it; ~¥2,000–3,000 per bag. Keep what you need for Ghibli Park + the evening.

todos.text: Send the big bags Hotel Granvia Kyoto → Swissotel Nankai Osaka by takkyubin (next-day)
todos.note: Or use the same-day hands-free luggage counter at Kyoto Station on the morning of Oct 12.

todos.text: At KIX: customs tax-refund check BEFORE security (passport + unused tax-free goods + receipts)
todos.note: Japan's refund-type tax-free system (since 2026-11-01): customs confirms the export, then stores refund to the card. Liquids (whisky/sake) in the checked bag.
